lighthouseConcepts.title: Slot
lighthouseConcepts.blurb: A single chance for a validator to propose a block. Lighthouse processes them as fast as the network can deliver attestations.

lighthouseConcepts.title: Epoch
lighthouseConcepts.blurb: ≈ 6.4 minutes. Finality is two epochs of justification - Lighthouse tracks justification and finalization independently for safety.

lighthouseConcepts.title: Validator Participation
lighthouseConcepts.blurb: Share of active validators whose attestations were included on time. A dip is the first signal of consensus stress.

lighthouseConcepts.title: Attestation Aggregation
lighthouseConcepts.blurb: Lighthouse aggregates BLS signatures per committee - the linchpin that lets Ethereum scale to ~1M validators.

updates.title: Pectra hard fork
updates.summary: Combines Prague (EL) and Electra (CL). Bumps MAX_EFFECTIVE_BALANCE from 32 → 2048 ETH (EIP-7251) and adds smart-account EOA upgrades (EIP-7702).

updates.title: EIP-7702 - set EOA code
updates.summary: Lets externally-owned accounts temporarily run contract code for a single tx. Reduces UX friction without requiring full ERC-4337 migration.

updates.title: Blob throughput tuning
updates.summary: Post-Dencun blob target / max are being re-evaluated to balance L2 fee compression against historical-state burden on full nodes.

updates.title: Verkle / PeerDAS research
updates.summary: Statelessness via Verkle trees and data-availability sampling via PeerDAS - both shape what consensus clients like Lighthouse will look like in 2026+.
